'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Hodur DS My Kind Of Scum''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hodur]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|JPSD-D-mykindofscum.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
